text: 上交所：10月26日至2026年10月30日，上交所对108起拉抬打压、虚假申报等证券异常交易行为采取了自律监管措施，对31起上市公司重大事项等进行专项核查，向证监会上报涉嫌违法违规案件线索2起。
text_en: SSE: From October 26 to October 30, 2026, the SSE took self-regulatory measures against 108 cases of abnormal securities trading such as ramping up and suppressing prices and false declarations, conducted special verifications of 31 major matters of listed companies, and reported 2 leads on suspected violations of laws and regulations to the CSRC.
